description: Look up one loan by its 8-digit HUD project (FHA) number: every field HUD publishes for it, plus years left, the property page URL, HUD physical inspection scores (latest and up to two prior, with release dates and REAC/NSPIRE scoring) and active Section 8 / rental assistance contracts (assisted units, expiration, latest renewal option), each with HUD as-of date and source, and location (HUD hub and servicing site, census tract, 2026 and 2027 Qualified Census Tract and Difficult Development Area status).
name: get_loan
title: Get one FHA-insured apartment loan
